Stuffed Rolled Rib Roast
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, December 24, 2009 - 12:33am

Ingredients




4 ounces thinly sliced, fully cooked ham, chopped (1 c.)
3 slices bacon, snipped
1/4 cup chopped onion
2 tablespoons chopped pimiento green olives
1 clove garlic, minced
1 beaten egg
1 (4-5 lb.) boneless beef rib roast

Preparation

1 In bowl combine chopped ham, snipped bacon, onion, olives, garlic and beaten egg. Unroll roast spread ham mixture over meat. Re-roll roast; tie securely. Place roast, fat side up, on rack in shallow roasting pan. Roast, uncovered at 325 degrees for about 3 hours for rare, 4 hours for medium. Let stand about 15 minutes. Remove strings and carve. Makes 12 to 15 servings.
